details.description: Cockroach Killing Chalk. "The Original Laxmanrekhaa", for eradicating crawling household insects like cockroaches. This product has created its presence not only in India but also in the international markets and has been well accepted by people all over the world. Use: Draw 2-3 lines of The Original Laxmanrekhaa chalk in the region where a cockroach is there.
